title: Understanding MSE on Test Data
text: When you add a new feature to a model, especially one that is a transformation of an existing feature, it can affect the model's ability to generalize to new data. Consider how adding complexity might lead to overfitting or underfitting.

title: Effect of Adding Features
text: Adding a feature that is a transformation of an existing feature can increase the model's flexibility. Think about how this might impact the model's variance and its performance on unseen data.
